nodes.label: DRIFT — streetwear drop template
nodes.rationale: Grafisch-tier fashion template (cobalt x hot pink x acid, Archivo Black). Archetype F applied to drop culture: fixed vertical rail nav, pink drop-bar announcing scarcity (oplage 200, weg is weg), giant-type hero with stroke text, horizontal lookbook strip, limited-edition product grid with sold-out states, early-access signup form.

nodes.label: Horizontal lookbook strip (scroll-snap + card-step buttons)
nodes.rationale: Signature component: full-bleed dark strip with scroll-snap cards separated by 3px borders; prev/next buttons scroll exactly one card width via scrollBy, honoring prefers-reduced-motion. Focusable role=region with drag/arrow hint text.
